description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Renderer' in the MigraDoc.Rendering namespace. The class provides core rendering functionalities for document objects such as layout calculation and drawing, and serves as a foundation for specific renderer implementations like ParagraphRenderer, TableRenderer, etc.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: Abstract base class for all renderers, providing core methods for rendering, formatting, and creating specific renderer instances based on document object types.

methods.name: Renderer
methods.description: Constructors initializing the renderer with graphics context and document object information.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Abstract method for rendering the document object onto the graphics context.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Abstract method for laying out the document object within a specified area.

methods.name: Create (static)
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate specific renderer types based on the type of document object.

methods.name: Create (static, with RenderInfo)
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate specific renderer types based on stored rendering information.
